title: Amazonas-Kipppunkt — interactive double-well sandbox for amazon-utac (P19)
description: Interactive physics sandbox for the Amazon forest-savanna transition, porting the cubic double-well ODE from GenesisAeon's amazon-utac (P19) savanna_attractor.py -- no invented numbers. Keeps the legacy 1%/yr deforestation-rate model assumption explicitly separate from the observed INPE PRODES 2024/2025 consolidated rate of 0.16%/yr. Calibrated against Lovejoy & Nobre (2019) and Boulton et al. (2022). Part of the GenesisAeon interactive-sandbox series.
